scope: Admin attribute-set manager: list reusable attribute sets, create a set, add/remove global attribute definitions with per-assignment required/sort order, and assign/unassign the set to categories

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog Attribute sets tab lists the nine seeded sets and supports the full set lifecycle: create a set, add a global attribute, assign a category, then remove/unassign

notes: The Attribute sets tab (Magento attribute-set pattern) lists the nine seeded sets with human-readable names and counts. Manage opens a scrollable modal showing the set's items (label · key · type · required) with Remove, an Add-attribute form (definition select + sort order + required), the assigned categories with Unassign, and an Assign-category form. Verified headed end-to-end: created "Verify Set", added the global Casing definition to it (item count 0→1), assigned the Accessory category (category count 0→1); the added attribute and assigned category dropped out of the available-select options; then the test set was removed via SQL. No console errors.
